```{r }
#| fig-cap: Difference between the proportion of primary residences and contact venues in each community district, highlighting areas over-represented among venues.
#| label: fig-spatial-concentration-bar
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

targets::tar_read(plotdata_spatial_concentration_bar) |>
  plot_home_vs_residence_dbn_bar() +
  scale_alpha_mpxnyc() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "Borough", option = "dark") +
  scale_axis_mpxnyc("SPATIAL CONCENTRATION") +
  theme_mpxnyc_matrix_movement(
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#636363", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#636363", size = 0.1),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete("COMMUNITY DISTRICT")


```
